changes.reason_quote: Appointment of Smt. Vibha Thakkar as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company w.e.f October 31, 2026
changes.profile: Smt. Vibha Thakkar is a qualified Chartered Accountant with over 18 years of experience across finance functions in various verticals. She previously served as AVP - Finance & Accounts at NOCIL Limited and held roles at VIP Industries Limited, Greaves Cotton Limited, Sandoz Private Limited, and KPMG. She holds a Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, a General Management Program from ISB, and was featured under the '40 Under 40' category by Tradeflock in 2025.
changes.profile_quote: Smt. Vibha Thakkar is a qualified Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). She has over 18 years of rich and progressive experience across finance functions in diverse industry verticals including Speciality chemicals, FMCG, Automotive, Pharmaceuticals and Big4 consultings.
